summary: Xylem Inc. filed an 8-K on September 29, 2026, disclosing completion of a $1.5 billion public offering of senior notes in three tranches ($500 million each: 5.250% due 2029, 5.450% due 2032, 5.850% due 2037). Net proceeds, combined with cash on hand, will finance all or a portion of the purchase price for the previously announced acquisition of the Cornell Pump and Roper Pump businesses. The notes are senior unsecured obligations. A special mandatory redemption at 101% applies if the equity purchase agreement terminates or the acquisition does not close by August 10, 2027. Watch deal-close timing and leverage impact.
